ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-26-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day for Name and Gender Change.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo, CSR: David Davenport.
Petitioner, Jacqueline Alcantara present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to Jack Alcantara and Gender from female to male.
Decree signed in open court.
